startMessage.line1: You talk fine normally—so why do you only stumble in front of them?
startMessage.line2: With friends the chatter never stops, but around your crush it turns into "uh… wait… um…" over and over. The line you meant to say only shows up later—usually while kicking the blanket at home.
startMessage.line3: Getting tongue-tied has different reasons for different people. Maybe you're over-aware, trying to look perfect, scared of being judged, too fluttered, or quietly defending yourself by saying less. Once you know why, talking gets easier.
startMessage.line4: Across ten situations, we'll show what's really making you tongue-tied—and how to speak more comfortably.
